# Synthetic fixture (INF07-01): compute declared on older or x86 families with a more efficient equivalent.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Parameters:
  BastionType:
    Type: String
    Default: t2.micro
    AllowedValues: [t2.micro, t3.micro, t4g.micro]
Resources:
  WebServer:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: m4.large
      ImageId: ami-0123456789abcdef0
  Bastion:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: !Ref BastionType
  WorkerTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        InstanceType: c4.xlarge
  WorkerGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      MinSize: "1"
      MaxSize: "4"
      MixedInstancesPolicy:
        LaunchTemplate:
          LaunchTemplateSpecification:
            LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WorkerTemplate
            Version: !GetAtt WorkerTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
          Overrides:
            - InstanceType: m7g.large
            - InstanceType: m5.large
  Nodes:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Nodegroup
    Properties:
      ClusterName: app
      NodeRole: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/node
      Subnets: [subnet-1]
      InstanceTypes: [t3.medium]
  OrdersDb:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: postgres
      DBInstanceClass: db.r4.large
  ReportsDb:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.m5.large
  SessionCache:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::CacheCluster
    Properties:
      Engine: redis
      NumCacheNodes: 1
      CacheNodeType: cache.t2.micro
  SearchDomain:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchService::Domain
    Properties:
      ClusterConfig:
        InstanceType: m4.large.search
        InstanceCount: 2
  ResizeFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/fn
      Code:
        ZipFile: "def handler(event, context): return event"
  ApiFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      CodeUri: src/
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
